label: Ens realissimum in the reconstruction: RealityProfile supplies positive features, and MostReal…
definition: RealityProfile supplies positive features, and MostReal means possessing every such feature. Adequacy of the interpretation of positive reality remains open. This is not identity with the Catholic God, Scott God-likeness, or the Fourth Way’s maximum in being.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
